recipes.saga: Sable seats two ember crystals in a plain iron band — and it remembers a purpose.
Emberhand's coil is wound while the iron still sings; an aether shard keeps it from cooling.
A heartstone shard cut flush to silver — it dims slightly every time it turns a blow.
An Oathweld medallion set with ember crystal — the ward holds because the smith believed in it.
A teardrop of pressed aether in silver filigree — the light inside was caught before the Heart went quiet.
City-mark work of the Bright Centuries, bound around a heartstone — the old glyph for the Heart, before anyone thought it needed protecting.
